title: Linear lower bound for a C¹ map near a point where its derivative is injective
statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝᵐ be open, let φ : ℝᵐ → ℝ^N be C¹ on V (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ V), let v₀ ∈ V, and suppose that Dφ(v₀) := fderiv ℝ φ v₀ is injective. Then there exist c > 0 and δ > 0 such that the closed ball B_δ(v₀) is contained in V and c‖w‖ ≤ ‖φ(v₀ + w) − φ(v₀)‖ for every w ∈ ℝᵐ with ‖w‖ ≤ δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn m)) (φ : Rn m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (v₀ : Rn m), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ V → v₀ ∈ V → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ φ v₀) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ closedBall v₀ δ ⊆ V ∧ ∀ w : Rn m, ‖w‖ ≤ δ → c * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖φ (v₀ + w) - φ v₀‖
